story_title: A Season at the North Pole Research Station
task_instruction: Rewrite each sentence in the opposite voice: change active sentences to passive and passive sentences to active.
paragraphs: At a research station near the North Pole, a team studies sea ice and changing weather. Dr. Chen leads the morning briefing. {{red:The researchers collect snow samples before sunrise.}} {{mask_1}} {{red:Satellite images are reviewed by the data team each morning.}} {{mask_2}} {{red:The station has recorded wind speeds above one hundred kilometers per hour.}} {{mask_3}} {{red:Several weather instruments were repaired by the technicians last week.}} {{mask_4}}

The team prepares equipment for a trip across the ice. {{red:Dr. Chen is checking the navigation system now.}} {{mask_5}} {{red:The emergency supplies have been packed by the field crew.}} {{mask_6}} {{red:Researchers will measure the thickness of the ice along the route.}} {{mask_7}} {{red:The route is marked by the safety officer before each trip.}} {{mask_8}}

During fieldwork, the scientists record observations and protect their equipment. {{red:A group of seals was tracked by the team when the fog arrived.}} {{mask_9}} {{red:The return journey was delayed by a sudden change in the weather.}} {{mask_10}} {{red:The collected samples are being stored in a cold laboratory.}} {{mask_11}} {{red:The researchers have updated the station log with their measurements.}} {{mask_12}}

Back at the station, the data team compares its results with satellite records. {{red:Analysts may identify a new pattern in the sea-ice data.}} {{mask_13}} {{red:The station director will present the findings at a research meeting.}} {{mask_14}} {{red:The team had checked every instrument before the winter survey began.}} {{mask_15}} {{red:New safety guidelines are being prepared by the expedition leaders.}} {{mask_16}}

As winter continues, the station crew maintains its routines and shares information. {{red:Technicians must test the backup generator every week.}} {{mask_17}} {{red:The weekly weather summary is sent to partner institutes by the research team.}} {{mask_18}} {{red:Scientists could use these observations to improve future ice forecasts.}} {{mask_19}} {{red:The final report will be reviewed by an independent panel before publication.}} {{mask_20}} The researchers continue their work while following careful procedures in the extreme environment.
